 def list_recent_users(limit: int = 10):
     conn = sqlite3.connect("app.db")
     cur = conn.execute(
         "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?",
         (limit,),
     )
     return cur.fetchall()
